Method of Attack: Exploits Microsoft Teams vulnerabilities to create a reverse shell using base64 encoded GIFs, bypasses security controls, modifies attachments to download malicious files, uses insecure URLs for NTLM hash theft or relay attacks, and exfiltrates data via GIF file names.
Attack Vector: Malicious stager installed on victim's machine, base64 encoded GIFs transmitted via Microsoft Teams, external URL downloads, insecure URLs for NTLM attacks, and Microsoft servers fetching GIFs from remote servers.
Indicators of Compromise: Forged attachments appearing as harmless files
GIF file names used for data exfiltration
